quality.scale: linear camera RGB, no WB, matrix, clipping, denoise or tone curve
quality.aggregation: sum squared error / sample count by category, split and phase; publish aggregate and worst phase; border separately; also report worst individual scene/phase as diagnostics, without changing the category/phase gates
promotion_requires: all synthetic gates on development and held-out validation
measured sites exact and finite extended float on all four Bayer phases
quality.holdout_policy: Do not tune a submitted candidate after inspecting validation. A later candidate requires a new independent holdout.
quality.validation_limits: New parameter holdout from the same analytic scene families; not independent photographic validation.
quality.spatial_stress_contract: Two crossed sinusoid frequencies (split indices 1,3), achromatic/chromatic; stationary noise n=(z+0.6*z shifted six columns)/sqrt(1.36), sigma 0.012/0.04, two flat colors, row-periodic noise boundary.

validation_generation.algorithm: Python random.Random (MT19937), uniform stratified, rounded once
validation_generation.policy: single draw before candidate measurements; no selection based on results
validation_generation.draw_order: wave phase, edge offset, four angles, two frequencies per band; scalar flat/noise colors and dimensions declared independently
